item.title: Philadelphia weather: Wintry mix to create messy Thursday morning commute
item.description: A messy wintry mix of rain and wet snow is expected to create a slippery Thursday morning commute in Philadelphia and the suburbs. A cloudy and mild Wednesday is forecasted for Philadelphia on Wednesday, with highs expected to reach the mid-50s. item.title: 4-alarm fire breaks out at Atlantic City apartment high-rise near Tropicana Hotel & Casino
item.description: Firefighters in Atlantic City battled a 4-alarm apartment fire early Wednesday morning that erupted near one of the shore town's most popular casinos. Firefighters from the Atlantic City Fire Department were called to the Brighton Towers apartment building near the Tropicana Hotel and Casino around 5 a.m. Officials say heavy flames consumed parts of the 8th floor and climbed to several floors above in the 13-story high rise.
